en.title: Web Development in Toronto | Agile Tech Specialists
en.description: Top-rated web development in Toronto. We build custom websites and applications that fuel business growth across Canada.
en.h1: Canada's Financial Capital Gets Enterprise Web Engineering
en.p: AVPdev delivers high-load Next.js platforms and smart Telegram automation for Toronto's fintech, real estate, and enterprise sectors.

benefits.title: Fast Launch
benefits.desc: We launch MVP projects in the shortest possible time, saving your budget.

benefits.title: Backend & Web Apps
benefits.desc: We architect fault-tolerant web applications and complex APIs tailored to your business needs.

benefits.title: Automation & Bots
benefits.desc: We automate business processes by developing smart Telegram bots and custom scraping systems.

faq.q: Do you only build traditional websites?
faq.a: No, we specialize in high-load Web Apps, PWAs, Telegram bots, and complex data collection scripts (scrapers).

faq.q: How is the project cost estimated?
faq.a: Pricing is calculated individually based on the technical specification. Effort varies greatly between a simple landing page and a complex web app.

benefits.title: SEO Optimization
benefits.desc: All websites are developed taking into account current search engine algorithms for better ranking.

faq.q: What is the cost of web development in Toronto?
faq.a: Pricing starts from $400 for Astro landing pages and $600 for Next.js websites. Custom web applications start from $1500.
Astro landing pages take 7–14 days. Full Next.js websites take 2–4 weeks, and complex custom systems take 4–12 weeks.

faq.q: Do you develop Telegram bots and Mini Apps?
faq.a: Yes, we build intelligent bots for business automation. Prices start from $150 depending on the requirements.

Yes. All work comes with a 1-month warranty after launch, covering bug fixes in delivered functionality (the number of revision iterations depends on project complexity). Beyond that, ongoing technical support and development are available on separate terms: uptime monitoring, security updates, and new features.

faq.q: What tech stack do you use?
faq.a: We specialize in Next.js, React, Node.js, and Astro. This stack ensures the best performance, scalability, and SEO results.
